name: Clickbait skipper
tagline: Skips the padding and tells you what a video or podcast actually says
description: Paste a link to a YouTube video or a podcast episode, or attach the media file itself, and you get the substance with none of the build-up. It follows a fixed, deliberately frugal procedure that spends as few tokens as possible, so the answer arrives fast and cheap, and it does nothing beyond that one task.
author: S_Padival
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
